players.product: Mozaic HAMR nearline HDDs (44TB Mozaic 4+ -> 50TB Mozaic 5) for AI mass-capacity storage

quarterly_data.signal: Seagate's 10-K: as of July 3, 2026 it had unconditional purchase obligations of approximately $2.1 billion, primarily for inventory components ($1.6 billion expected to be paid within one year), plus certain long-term market share based non-cancellable inventory purchase commitments, and unconditional commitments of $465 million primarily for equipment (approximately $375 million expected within one year). Supporting the volume ramp of hard drives using HAMR technology, Seagate expects fiscal 2027 capital expenditures to be higher than fiscal 2026 and still within its target range of 4-6% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase obligations ~$2.1 billion ($1.6 billion within one year); equipment commitments $465 million (~$375 million within one year); fiscal 2027 capex above fiscal 2026, within 4-6% of revenue
